title: MeteringValue
description: A metering data record representing resource consumption for billing purposes.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the metering period.

computeUnitHours.description: The number of compute unit hours consumed during the metering period. Compute units are based on memory and vCPU allocation.

storageGB.description: The storage consumption in gigabytes during the metering period.

dataLakeCapacityGB.description: The data lake storage consumption in gigabytes during the metering period, if a data lake instance is attached.

backupStorageGB.description: The backup storage consumption in gigabytes during the metering period.
